description: Re-run a listed FinzData strategy exactly as published, on its full point-in-time history through end (default today), on the FinzData servers. Free on every plan. Saves spec.json and result.json to /workspace/strategies/<slug>/ so you can analyse them with workspace_run. Changing the strategy or testing your own idea over full history needs a FinzData purchase; the free window still applies there.
name: strategy_run
title: Re-run a FinzData strategy
